meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'confess, admit'.

examples.text: J'avoue que j'ai un trac terrible.
examples.trans: I confess that I have terrible stage fright.

examples.text: Tu n'aimais pas Mandelieu? C'est un bel endroit.
examples.trans: Didn't you like Mandelieu? It's a lovely place.

meanings.note: before the noun; bel before a vowel: un bel endroit
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
used for both masculine and feminine

examples.text: Ensuite, parce qu'elle est ma collègue et mon amie.
examples.trans: Second, because she is my colleague and my friend.

examples.text: J'ai peur de perdre la confiance de mes collègues.
examples.trans: I am afraid of losing the trust of my colleagues.

meanings.note: Prefix 'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'. Standard masculine noun meaning 'conspiracy, plot'.

examples.trans: Is it a conspiracy or what?

examples.text: Il y a un complot contre lui.
examples.trans: There is a plot against him.

examples.text: C'est une belle théorie du complot.
